Topic.label: Representing Irrational Numbers on the Number Line Using the Pythagorean Theorem

Question: How can you construct the point representing \(\sqrt{5}\) on the number line? (Choose the correct construction.)

Choices.A: Construct a right triangle with legs of lengths 2 and 1. Draw an arc centered at the origin with radius equal to the hypotenuse length to intersect the positive half of the number line.
Choices.B: Construct a right triangle with legs of lengths 1 and 1. Draw an arc centered at the origin with radius equal to the hypotenuse length to intersect the positive half of the number line.
Choices.C: Construct a right triangle with legs of lengths 2 and 3. Draw an arc centered at the origin with radius equal to the hypotenuse length to intersect the positive half of the number line.

Solution: Since \(2^2+1^2=5\), the hypotenuse has length \(\sqrt{5}\). Drawing an arc centered at the origin to intersect the positive half of the number line gives the point representing \(\sqrt{5}\). Legs of lengths 1 and 1 give \(\sqrt{2}\), while legs of lengths 2 and 3 give \(\sqrt{13}\).

Original.prompt: 怎样在数轴上作出表示 √5 的点？（选出正确的作法）

choices.text: 作直角边为 2 与 1 的直角三角形，以原点为圆心、斜边长为半径画弧交数轴正半轴
作直角边为 1 与 1 的直角三角形，以原点为圆心、斜边长为半径画弧交数轴正半轴
作直角边为 2 与 3 的直角三角形，以原点为圆心、斜边长为半径画弧交数轴正半轴

Original.explanation: 2²+1²=5，斜边长为 √5，以原点为圆心画弧交数轴正半轴即得 √5 对应的点。直角边 1、1 得 √2，直角边 2、3 得 √13。
